rung: canonical two-seed outcome-trained raw-value structure-policy transfer

accounting.stable_bits_to_threshold: 50000 generic scalar-utility updates; rank-1 held-out accuracy remained at or above 0.80 on both promotion seeds

accounting.transfer_ratio_against_fresh_learner: trained rank-1 held-out accuracy exceeded fresh by 0.890625 on seed 17 and 0.328125 on seed 18; ranks 2 and 4 passed the held-out gates

controls: old route retention after successor growth
forward and reversed physical row order
10k and 20k under-training calibration retained as rejected evidence
next_bottleneck: Online repeated structure discovery under alternating growth and reversal, plus reducing the scalar-feedback budget without adding a candidate-error shortcut.
